title: Stage 4 host-self synchronization corrective authority

problem.workflow_failure_mask_reason: node verifier was piped through tee without bash pipefail
problem.self_reference: The tracked registry lock snapshots HEI verification.build.commit, but any Stage 4 merge changes the live HEI build commit again, so a static host-self verification commit cannot reach a fixed point.

corrective_design.local_host_source: the locally generated HEI /data/series/registry.json produced earlier in the same deterministic build
corrective_design.remote_registry_source: reviewed tracked descriptor lock for the other seven registries
corrective_design.reason: The temporary host must describe its own current build from the same build output while all non-host registries remain reviewed lock inputs.

allowed_implementation: adjust the Stage 4 registry-index builder so only the HEI row is projected from the locally generated HEI Series descriptor
keep the other seven registries sourced from the reviewed tracked descriptor lock
refresh reviewed non-HEI descriptor snapshots when live vertical drift is confirmed before the corrective merge
adjust the Stage 4 validator and read-only CI to require local-host descriptor parity plus reviewed-lock parity for the other seven registries
rerun fail-close exact-main production synchronization across all eight live descriptors
update Stage 4 coordination evidence and close the verification-only PR without merge after successful acceptance
forbidden: cross-registry relationship publication or Stage 5 implementation
Search, Compare, Stats or UI behavior changes
Cloudflare account, DNS, hostname or project configuration mutation
weakening live synchronization checks for the seven non-host registries
treating HEI as semantic owner of other registries
acceptance: this corrective authority PR is merged before any corrective runtime/public-output write
corrective implementation is limited to Stage 4 source/builder/validator/CI changes and any reviewed non-HEI lock refresh needed for current live synchronization
existing HEI CI and dedicated Stage 4 validation are green on the exact corrective head
corrective implementation is merged to main
production /version.json reports the exact corrective main commit
the public HEI row equals the live local-host HEI Series descriptor for that exact deployed build
the other seven public registry rows equal their reviewed lock projections and all seven live production descriptors at acceptance
all eight identities, origins, counts, capabilities, verification facts and data-safety facts agree under the Stage 4 registry-level contract
the fail-close production verifier exits successfully without pipeline masking
accepted run/job and synchronized registry facts are recorded in Issue #780
preview_reason: The correction is deterministic static machine-readable generation with no Cloudflare-specific routing, redirect, header, DNS, project, or UI behavior. Repository CI plus exact-main production verification is the release gate.
